anchor: Seven days before Naruto's Academy graduation

events.title: Konohagakure is founded
events.summary: Hashirama Senju and Madara Uchiha end generations of clan warfare, founding Konohagakure together; Hashirama becomes its First Hokage.

events.title: Hashirama defeats Madara Uchiha
events.summary: Madara Uchiha attacks Konoha and is defeated by Hashirama Senju in their legendary battle, later commemorated by the carved cliffs of the Valley of the End.

events.title: The First Shinobi World War ends
events.summary: The war closes with Tobirama Senju's death; Hiruzen Sarutobi becomes the Third Hokage in the aftermath.

events.title: The Second Shinobi World War begins
events.summary: War breaks out across the shinobi nations; Kurama, the Nine-Tails, is sealed into Kushina Uzumaki, making her its second jinchuriki.

events.title: Sakumo Hatake's death
events.summary: The White Fang of Konoha takes his own life after being condemned for choosing to save his comrades over completing a mission — a shadow that will hang over his son Kakashi for years.

events.title: The original Akatsuki is founded
events.summary: Yahiko, Nagato, and Konan establish the original Akatsuki as an Amegakure peace movement. The player's decisions can shape its charter, methods, allies, and relationship with Hanzō from its first day.

events.title: The Kannabi Bridge mission
events.summary: Rin Nohara dies and Obito Uchiha is believed killed during a mission gone wrong; Kakashi inherits Obito's Sharingan, and both awaken the Mangekyō Sharingan in their grief.

events.title: Yahiko's death and Akatsuki's transformation
events.summary: Yahiko dies after Hanzō and Danzō force a cruel choice on Nagato. The original peace movement survives under a grief-stricken Nagato, while the masked shinobi calling himself Madara begins steering it toward the darker organization later feared as Akatsuki.

events.title: Naruto's birth and the Nine-Tails attack
events.summary: Naruto is born as Obito's attack breaks Kushina's seal; Minato and Kushina confront the Nine-Tails while Konoha fights for survival.

events.title: Might Duy's sacrifice
events.summary: Might Duy rescues Guy, Ebisu, and Genma from the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist, killing two of them before dying from opening the Eight Gates.

events.title: The Hyūga Affair
events.summary: After Hiashi Hyūga kills a Kumogakure envoy in retaliation for an attempted kidnapping, his twin brother Hizashi sacrifices his own life under the branch seal to satisfy the peace treaty.

events.title: The Uchiha Massacre
events.summary: Itachi Uchiha kills nearly his entire clan in a single night under Konoha's own order to prevent a coup, sparing only his younger brother Sasuke. The truth behind why is hidden from the village for years.

events.title: Academy graduation night — the Mizuki incident
events.summary: Naruto's graduation is followed the same night by Mizuki's betrayal: he tricks Naruto into stealing the Forbidden Scroll of Seals before being stopped, and the new genin generation begins forming.

events.title: Ninja Registration Day
events.summary: Naruto is formally registered as a shinobi of the Hidden Leaf, and meets Konohamaru for the first time.

events.title: The Graduation Ceremony
events.summary: Twenty-seven students graduate into nine three-person genin teams.

events.title: Team 7 is formed
events.summary: Kakashi Hatake accepts Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura as Team 7, alongside the formation of Team 8 and Team 10.

events.title: D-rank missions begin
events.summary: Team 7 starts a run of menial village chores and errands — the unglamorous reality before real missions are trusted to them.

events.title: The client's request
events.summary: A traveling bridge-builder requests an escort mission undersold as routine, setting up a far more dangerous job than advertised.

events.title: Land of Waves mission begins
events.summary: Team 7 begins the bridge-builder escort mission and is immediately ambushed, then confronted by the missing-nin Zabuza Momochi, revealing the client's true danger.

events.title: Zabuza's ambush
events.summary: The Demon of the Hidden Mist attacks the escort team directly, aided by his masked companion Haku.

events.title: A quiet conversation in the woods
events.summary: Haku speaks candidly about strength and precious people with Naruto in the forest, neither realizing they'll soon meet as enemies.

events.title: Battle of the Great Naruto Bridge
events.summary: Zabuza and Haku are confronted a final time; Haku dies protecting Zabuza, Zabuza kills Gato, and dies from Gato's men's wounds. The bridge battle reshapes Team 7's understanding of shinobi life and death.

events.title: Team 7 returns from the Land of Waves
events.summary: Team 7 completes the Naruto Bridge and returns home, resuming routine missions.

events.title: Chūnin Exam nominations
events.summary: Jōnin instructors across the village nominate their genin teams for the upcoming Chūnin Exams as foreign shinobi begin arriving in Konoha.

events.title: Chūnin Exams begin
events.summary: Genin from multiple villages gather for the written exam and the Forest of Death survival trial. Orochimaru infiltrates the exam and marks Sasuke with the cursed seal.

events.title: Chūnin Exam preliminaries
events.summary: One-on-one preliminary matches thin the surviving genin ahead of the final tournament, revealing hidden strength and rivalries; Naruto meets Jiraiya the same night.

events.title: One month of final-round training
events.summary: Finalists scatter to train intensively before the Chūnin Exam finals — Naruto with Jiraiya, Sasuke with Kakashi — each seeking an edge from a mentor or hidden technique.

events.title: The curse mark's temptation
events.summary: Sasuke wrestles with the cursed seal's promised power as Kakashi works out a way to counter it before the finals.

events.title: Chūnin Exam finals and the Konoha Crush
events.summary: The exam finals become the cover for a coordinated invasion by Sunagakure and Otogakure; the Third Hokage, Hiruzen Sarutobi, dies sealing away Orochimaru's arms — unless prior divergences alter the outcome.

events.title: The search for Tsunade begins
events.summary: With Itachi and Kisame sighted entering the village, Jiraiya and Naruto set out to track down the Sannin Tsunade and convince her to become the Fifth Hokage.

events.title: Tsunade becomes Fifth Hokage
events.summary: Tsunade returns to Konoha with Naruto and Jiraiya and formally accepts the title of Fifth Hokage.

events.title: Sasuke's Departure
events.summary: Consumed by the pull of Orochimaru's power, Sasuke abandons Konoha in the night after clashing with Naruto on the hospital rooftop.

events.title: Sasuke Retrieval Mission
events.summary: A team of genin pursues Sasuke to bring him back, each facing one of Orochimaru's Sound Four in a running battle that costs the team dearly; Naruto and Sasuke's confrontation at the Valley of the End ends with Sasuke continuing on to Orochimaru.

events.title: Naruto departs with Jiraiya
events.summary: Naruto leaves Konoha with Jiraiya for two and a half years of training, after Jiraiya tells him of Akatsuki's true threat.

events.title: Naruto returns after the training journey
events.summary: Naruto and Jiraiya return to the village after roughly two and a half years, and Naruto retakes Kakashi's old bell test alongside Sakura.

events.title: Gaara's death and rescue
events.summary: Akatsuki's Deidara and Sasori extract Shukaku from Gaara, killing him; Sakura and Chiyo defeat Sasori, and Chiyo sacrifices her own life to revive Gaara — the crew's first direct confrontation with Akatsuki.

events.title: Asuma Sarutobi's death
events.summary: Hidan of Akatsuki kills Asuma Sarutobi before Shikamaru's team avenges him.

events.title: Jiraiya's death in Amegakure
events.summary: Jiraiya infiltrates Amegakure to learn the truth behind Pain, fights Pain and Konan, and dies delivering crucial intelligence back to Konoha with his final moments.

events.title: Itachi Uchiha's death
events.summary: Sasuke finally confronts and kills Itachi in single combat; Itachi, already dying of illness, ensures his brother survives the fight.

events.title: Itachi's Truth
events.summary: In the aftermath of Itachi's death, the truth of the Uchiha Massacre comes to light: Itachi acted under Konoha's own order to prevent a coup, sacrificing his name and his brother's hatred to protect the village he loved.

events.title: Pain's Assault on Konoha
events.summary: Pain launches a full assault on Konohagakure in pursuit of Naruto, leveling much of the village within minutes.

events.title: Naruto vs. Pain
events.summary: Naruto confronts Pain directly, ultimately learning Nagato's true identity and choosing to spare him — a choice that reshapes the Akatsuki leader's own resolve as he sacrifices himself to revive the villagers he killed.

events.title: The Five Kage Summit
events.summary: The Five Kage meet to decide how to respond to Akatsuki, only for Sasuke to attack the summit himself; the masked Akatsuki leader declares the Fourth Shinobi World War in the chaos that follows.

events.title: Obito's Reveal
events.summary: The masked man behind Akatsuki's true plan is revealed to be Obito Uchiha, Kakashi's presumed-dead teammate, radically reframing the entire war's cause.

events.title: The Fourth Shinobi World War begins
events.summary: The Allied Shinobi Forces mobilize against Akatsuki's reanimated army, opening the war that will decide the future of the shinobi world.

events.title: Kaguya's Appearance
events.summary: Obito casts the Infinite Tsukuyomi, but Black Zetsu's betrayal uses him to revive Kaguya Ōtsutsuki instead — a threat beyond anything the shinobi world has faced, who kills Obito himself moments later.

events.title: Naruto and Sasuke vs. Kaguya
events.summary: Naruto and a reconciled Sasuke seal Kaguya away for good, ending the Fourth Shinobi World War and the immediate threat to the entire world; Madara dies as the Ten-Tails is removed from him.

events.title: Naruto vs. Sasuke — Final Valley
events.summary: With the war won, Naruto and Sasuke settle their own long rivalry in a final, defining battle at the Valley of the End, each losing an arm before finally reconciling.

events.title: Kakashi becomes Sixth Hokage
events.summary: Kakashi Hatake is named the Sixth Hokage in the war's aftermath, the same month Sasuke leaves the village once more to atone for the past on his own terms.

events.title: Naruto and Hinata marry
events.summary: Naruto Uzumaki and Hinata Hyūga marry in Konohagakure, years after the war's end.

events.title: Naruto Becomes Hokage
events.summary: Naruto is formally named the Seventh Hokage, fulfilling his childhood dream and the village's recognition of everything he sacrificed to earn it.

events.title: Momoshiki and Kinshiki's attack
events.summary: During the Chūnin Exams hosted in Konoha, the Ōtsutsuki invaders Momoshiki and Kinshiki attack the village, forcing the next generation of shinobi into their first real crisis.
